results.name: Amazon history: the range Amazon shows in the page is remembered and drives the scanner when HAULS has little history
Amazon chart: the real Price-history SVG, when Amazon draws it, becomes HAULS's history (chart, high/low, verdict) and is merged with own points
how soon: 2-3 days / 1 week / 1 month changes a fair price from Buy to Wait, saves the choice, and offers an alert price
range selector: 30D/90D/1Y/All changes label, x-axis, y labels, chips; persists
notes: 30D: High chip ₹900 but chart top label ₹1,100 (chart carries in the price at window start, chips don't)
90D: High chip ₹1,100 but chart top label ₹1,300 (chart carries in the price at window start, chips don't)
1Y: High chip ₹1,300 but chart top label ₹1,500 (chart carries in the price at window start, chips don't)
